ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the reaction given in the image is 3NO2(g) + H2O(l) -> 2HNO3(aq) + NO(g), and it is labeled ΔH° = -135 kJ/mol_rxn. Then reason: the problem states that 1.0 mol NO2(g) is introduced into excess water, so water is in excess, and NO2 is the reactant that needs to be calculated according to amount. According to the stoichiometric coefficient in the image, 3 mol NO2 corresponds to 1 mol reaction. 1.0 mol NO2 corresponds to a reaction extent of 1.0/3 = 1/3 mol reaction. The energy change is (-135 kJ/mol_rxn) × (1/3 mol_rxn) = -45 kJ. The negative sign indicates that the reaction is exothermic, that is, energy is released.
